_doc: Proof-capture detectors. One entry per event type. A detector only decides WHEN to capture; every event gets the same staged capture (prices, oracle rounds, Aave/Morpho liquidations, venue liquidity) and receipt. Add a new event type by adding an entry with a known `kind` (price_drop, depeg). Thresholds: price_drop ~ the 1-in-1,000 hourly/8-hourly move (BTC 1h p99.9 -5.9%, 8h -15%; ETH 1h -7.7%, 8h -20% on 2018-2026 1m data), set a little inside it so the job fires on the 2-4 events a year that move liquidations, not on noise.
